_howto: Everything about where every family's military currently is -- the 'changes constantly' tier (unlike bodies.json/points_of_interest.json, which are the never/rarely-changes tiers and no longer carry a fleets field at all). 'stationed' = fleets sitting at a body right now (bodyId + fleets array of owner names, duplicates allowed for multiple fleets of the same family at one location). 'warpaths' = fleets in transit between two bodies (unchanged shape from before: ids=[from,to], name, color, type, owner, fleets array, descr, departure month). ADDITIVE DEFAULT: a family is assumed to keep any fleets not explicitly listed here at its companies.json 'planet' (home body) -- the map auto-fills the gap up to ceil(might/2) at load time, so you only need to record deviations (fleets away from home, or in transit), not a full roster for every family. A family's TOTAL fleet count (every appearance across both stationed[].fleets and warpaths[].fleets) should never exceed ceil(might/2) from companies.json -- the map shows a warning badge in a family's overlay if this is violated (this check only ever looks at explicit entries here, never at the auto-filled ones, so it still fires correctly).
